verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own rules-based workflows. They route requests to stakeholders automatically by vendor type, spend category or dollar amount (ramp-docs-23), notify people based on spend amount or team role (ramp-docs-12), and auto-approve in-policy spend under a customizable human-in-the-loop policy (ramp-docs-32, ramp-supp-agents-site). These rules are limited to approval routing, notifications and spend controls rather than general event-to-action automation; webhooks are a developer building block and are not credited here. Missing for 10: a general user-defined rule builder with arbitrary event triggers and custom actions, detailed docs on rule configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
